name: debounce-trailing
prompt: The debounce helper in src/debounce.js calls the function with the arguments of the FIRST call in a burst, so search boxes search for stale text. Fix it to use the arguments (and `this`) of the LAST call, and add two methods on the returned function: cancel() drops a pending call, and flush() runs a pending call immediately and returns its result (flush() with nothing pending returns undefined and calls nothing). Timers come from the optional third argument { setTimeout, clearTimeout } (defaulting to the globals), as today.
